points.evidence: Both original DBG boundaries remain excluded by #error; actual x86 preprocessing matches1218 shared selected lines. No new runtime change or restoration of excluded code.

Original SHAREVIOLATION converter allocates before putstr16/callback; exception bypasses normal free16. Existing call-local cleanup uses explicit WINAPI declarations and stack record; original has no exceptional resource owner. Keep one include, no new shim.

Original malloc16/putstr16/normal-free body is exercised by transaction family18; construction and copyback escape skip release. Capture completed acquisition in existing dwTmp[1]; incoming native lParam alone cannot identify owned guest allocation before conversion.
Original free16 does not consume the recorded key, so the required owner finalizer would release again. Single existing release call consumes before original free16 without replaying copyback.

Modern USER invokes the callback while original taskman execution can be parked in a native wait. callback_enter restores the selected task through original xxxDirectedYield/xxxSleepTask and grants a bounded alias borrow before the original body. Original GetCommdlgTd only reads CURRENTPTD chain; it cannot perform this missing native-host execution handoff. Keep body-only rename, remove comment; whole-TU rename would also redirect registrations away from the entry.

Same task/borrow boundary as normal dialog. Original setup callback reads and updates CURRENTPTD CommDlgTd and may GetWindow the owner before CallBack16. Guarding only the later CallBack16 is too late. Keep body-only rename, remove comment.

Common-dialog callback may reject IGNOREINPUT or fail before selecting/converting a message. Original uninitialized record cannot be passed to required cleanup: random uMsg/lpfnM32/keys can select or release unacquired resources. Zero existing per-call record, not another allocation registry.

Original selected converters may allocate callback stack before CallBack16. CallBack16 captures after that allocation, so its own recovery cannot restore this caller pre-conversion cursor. Constructor/copyback exceptions skip normal unthunk. Keep the single existing outer scope and finally.

Restore original immediate return. On this exact branch, no converter or guest callback ran. GETHWND16 is a cast; GetWindowLong GWL_HINSTANCE is negative-index public native query: client_try_get_long returns FALSE, wow_native_GetWindowLongA directly queries USER and only publishes GWL_HWNDPARENT. No stack/callback mutation occurs. Restoring the captured unchanged cursor is equivalent; old source-string assertion was not necessity evidence. Two INIT flag states pass unchanged-stack/flags/error/no-allocation assertions using exact selected filter and finalizer bodies.

Common-dialog source dispatches every uMsg<0x400 through aw32Msg, including WM_DDE_ACK. Original WM32DDEAck reads fFree to release the EXECUTE pair; original W32Win16WndProc sets TRUE for the same synchronous callback contract. Leaving this uninitialized or zero makes the release depend on stack garbage or suppresses it. Keep explicit policy; this is source-level DDE contract evidence, not a new real-guest common-dialog DDE reproduction.

Set completed only after successful original callback and output unthunk. Otherwise finalizer would roll back a successfully advanced call stack; existing normal versus abort stack fixture demonstrates the distinction. Error/early-return labels must not implicitly commit.

Keep finalizer order: release message resources, then restore the outer stack on unsuccessful/abnormal completion even if release throws. Remove redundant local abnormal: stack is caller-private and wow_message_unwind32 receives only wm32mpex, never this scope. Inline the same predicate at the same stack_leave call.

Original FindReplace WM_DESTROY releases guest template resources and host COMMDLGTD/FINDREPLACE records without invoking application hook. It must remain callable during task resource cleanup even when application callbacks are denied. Existing callback binding registers/consumes this original owner before guest teardown; source plus nested/exception/deny/resource-order fixture proves entry responsibilities. Keep body-only rename; remove comment.

counter_review: Verified filtered path cannot reach constructor/CallBack16; GWL_HINSTANCE bypasses private positive-index state and parent discovery. Existing stack scope remains private across message cleanup. Retained entry names in prototypes/registrations; only original body names differ. DBG boundaries and1218 line positions unchanged. Tests now observe filtered return state rather than require implementation marker.
limitations: Focused exact-body fixtures use bounded doubles; native references do not constitute full guest common-dialog acceptance.
DDE fFree necessity is source-contract evidence, not a new actual guest reproduction.
11 residual points await owner decision; no guest or winnt.zip changes; missing external fixtures remain skipped.
